description: This file contains utility functions used for testing and source code analysis within a PyTorch repository. It includes functions for handling pull requests, determining changed files, normalizing test ratings, and querying information from GitHub and Git. Key functionalities are centered on source file analysis, version control interactions, and test management.

methods.name: set[str] python_test_file_to_test_name(tests: set[str])
methods.description: Converts a set of test file paths into test names by removing prefix directory and file extension.

methods.name: int|None get_pr_number()
methods.description: Retrieves the current pull request number from environment variables or GitHub refs.

methods.name: str get_merge_base()
methods.description: Determines the common ancestor (merge base) between the current branch and the main branch or related PR base.

methods.name: list[str] query_changed_files()
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths that have changed between the merge base and current HEAD.

methods.name: str get_git_commit_info()
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs since the merge base for versioning or analysis.

methods.name: str get_issue_or_pr_body(number: int)
methods.description: Fetches the body text of a specified GitHub issue or pull request.

methods.name: dict[TestRun,float] normalize_ratings( ratings: dict[TestRun, float], max_value: float, min_value: float = 0 )
methods.description: Normalizes test ratings to a specified scale, maintaining proportional relationships.

methods.name: dict[str,float] get_ratings_for_tests(file: str | Path)
methods.description: Loads test ratings from a JSON file and adjusts them based on changed files.

methods.name: list[str] get_correlated_tests(file: str | Path)
methods.description: Ranks tests based on their ratings for prioritization.

ctags.name: normalize_ratings
ctags.signature: ( ratings: dict[TestRun, float], max_value: float, min_value: float = 0 )
